methods.native_feedback: Curl of fresh native advection of full flow, averaged in y, minus fresh native advection evaluated on its y-mean flow. Wave, explicit viscosity and maintained-background forcing remain in the retained mean equation.
methods.scalar_law: Qt+A=Rbar+viscous curl+forcing curl, A=mean_y(u qx+w qz). A retains in-plane eddy transport. This scalar Rbar is not the native counterfactual curl difference.
methods.native_normalization: Native 3D RMS divided by the sum of mean-advection RMS, wave RMS and RMS of viscosity plus compensating background force combined. The latter avoids diluting feedback with the two separately large laminar-maintenance terms. Raw component norms are also reported.
methods.filter: Nonperiodic Gaussian quadrature truncated at four sigma and row-normalized, applied to already formed signed terms. Widths scaled by deltaS=1/(2k); actual boundary widths and retained depths reported.
methods.temporal: Centered finite differences of saved Q maps, compared with fresh native tendencies. Two temporal strides are reported; residual is not pure dissipation.
methods.mode_supply: Parseval x-mode supplies to native y-mean in-plane kinetic energy, including mean mode. Cumulative 3D supplies include exchange with transverse modes and are not called a conservative inverse-cascade flux.
methods.matching: Same base initial field, wave state, viscosity, domain, grid and seed. Full x-z averaged fields and changed x-mean jet profiles compared separately. Finite perturbations add energy; no equal-total-energy causal claim.
methods.classification: No single chi, transverse-energy fraction or RMS correction determines a regime. Results are finite-time individual realizations; twin-amplitude collapse, numerical controls, signed effects and paired dynamics must be assessed together.

packet_reference.equation: F(Qt)+F(A)=F(Rbar)+F(unclosed), with A=B+E formed before filtering. F(Qt)+F(B)=F(C)+F(unclosed) is reported separately.
packet_reference.norm_definition: Physical-cell-thickness weighted RMS in x,z, after signed transverse and seven-seed averaging and fixed spatial filtering.
packet_reference.filter_definition: Separable Gaussian physical-volume quadrature; support within four sigma; row normalized on fixed bounded source domain. No periodic wrapping or extrapolation.
packet_reference.source_domain: x between 1 and 11 m; four z-edge cells excluded. Same fixed source domain at every time.
packet_reference.scope: Existing 1.D Eulerian packet-current comparison. No new simulation and no autonomous reduced-regime classification.
limits: No product of filtered primitive fields replaces filtered advection.
One-sided normalized Gaussian support near boundaries changes effective width and centroid; kernel ranges are reported.
Regional local-age masks are applied after filtering; no derivative of the time-dependent regional mask is claimed.
This is a fixed seven-seed mean. No population significance or simulation convergence is inferred.
Unclosed includes numerical and diagnostic terms; filtered residual is not identified with dissipation.
No native tendency counterfactual or matched two-dimensional simulation exists for this packet campaign.
Small filtered correction alone is not an automatic regime label or validation of the lab mechanism.
